objectives: Explain why Jacob left Laban and returned to his kindred.
Show from scripture that Laban was an idolater.
takeaways: Laban's countenance changed toward Jacob because of his sons' words, even after the Lord blessed him for Jacob's sake.
The Lord said, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and I will be with thee.
Rachel stole her father's images: she might have been fine, but she was a thief.
Wherefore hast thou stolen my gods? Laban was an idolater, of the house of Nahor that served other gods (Joshua 24:2).
That is why the Most High told Abram to get out from his kindred (Genesis 12:1).
